srcDivergence: Partially merged from the file (`record-src-reconcile`). GENUINELY STALE (fixed): the header read “live” where the file reads “· live”; the collapse control was an ASCII “x” with aria-label “Collapse stream” where the file uses “×” and the clearer “Collapse stream (agent stays alive)” — an ACCESSIBLE-NAME difference rather than a cosmetic one, since that label is what a screen reader announces and the whole point of the wording is that collapsing does NOT kill the agent; and the End-session title gained “so triage can be relaunched”. BY CONSTRUCTION (kept): the file mounts the real terminal, whose PTY cannot run in a preview, so the record renders a labelled placeholder in the stream pane. DELIBERATE RESIDUAL, not an oversight: the file grew a third `Plan` tab (#4102) and the record does not. The file renders that tab only when a `plan` prop is present — its own comment says an always-empty tab “would read as a bug” — and a preview has no plan, so [“stream”, “logs”] is exactly what the file renders in this situation too. Adding the tab body would mean importing `GlancePlanScreen` and `planScreenIssues` for a branch that can never be reached: an unresolvable dependency bought for nothing. Hand-merged, not copied.
